title: Questions in Geometric Group Theory — Q 1.1
exact_target: Suppose $G$ admits a finite $K(G,1)$. If $G$ does not contain any Baumslag-Solitar subgroups $BS(m,n)$, is $G$ necessarily hyperbolic? If $G$ embeds in a hyperbolic group, is it hyperbolic?
